The issuer exhibits an exceptionally strong balance sheet with a massive equity base ($64.92 billion) exceeding total liabilities ($57.55 billion), a healthy current ratio of 1.32, and substantial accumulated retained earnings ($68.46 billion) reflecting a long history of highly profitable operations. This solid capital structure is supported by robust profitability, evidenced by an 18% operating margin and $1.73 billion in quarterly net income, translating to extremely low default risk. While the liquidity profile is adequate and leverage is conservative, the asset-heavy nature of the balance sheet and moderate current ratio place it just below the highest possible sovereign-equivalent tiers, supporting a highly secure investment-grade rating in the double-A category.

DECISION: AA-
